title: SidecarJob (v2 additions)
description: Phase-2 sidecar surface: the open-kind sidecar_run_job command (debt D-07 paydown) and the per-kind params/result shapes for the generation job kinds. Stands BESIDE sidecar-job.schema.json (v1 kinds keep their dedicated commands; events/status shapes are unchanged, with `kind` now an OPEN string — consumers MUST render unknown kinds generically from progress+log). Emitter contract — no additionalProperties:false (D-06). API keys (e.g. ElevenLabs) travel via worker env vars, NEVER inside params.

jobKind.description: Open kind string. Kinds known to this app version are listed as examples; unknown kinds are rejected by sidecar_run_job but tolerated by all observers.

runJobRequest.title: RunJobRequest
runJobRequest.description: Arguments of sidecar_run_job (an event Channel is passed alongside as `onEvent`) and of the MCP run_sidecar_job tool.

params.description: Opaque per-kind blob, forwarded to the worker as --params-json. Known shapes below.

outputPath.description: Absolute path for the generated WAV.

aceStepRepaintParams.title: AceStepRepaintParams
aceStepRepaintParams.description: Inpaint/repaint a region of existing audio.

elevenLabsParams.title: ElevenLabsMusicParams
elevenLabsParams.description: Cloud generation; the worker reads ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from its environment.

amtInfillParams.title: AmtInfillParams
amtInfillParams.description: Conditioned MIDI infilling. All positions in TICKS at `ppq` (D-02).

contextNotes.description: Surrounding notes (clip-relative ticks) the model conditions on.

stableAudioSfzParams.title: StableAudioSfzParams
stableAudioSfzParams.description: Text -> multisampled SFZ instrument. Output MUST use only the AURA SFZ SUBSET v1 (src-tauri/src/audio/sampler.rs).

keys.description: MIDI keys to multisample (e.g. minor thirds C2..C6).

audioResult.title: AudioGenerationResult
audioResult.description: Done-event result for aceStep* and elevenLabsMusic.

sfzPath.description: Absolute path of the generated .sfz (AURA SFZ SUBSET v1).
